fix.item: Supply OctoJPack with the workflow's read-only GitHub token when the optional GIT_TOKEN secret is unset, so public tagged sources can be packaged.
Read MCP protocol identity and outbound API User-Agent versions from the native component manifest before and after installation.
Make the source ZIP directly installable with committed production dependencies, relocation-safe autoloading, catalogue seed and administrator licence.
Point component update discovery to the maintained native XML feed.

addition.item: Document the complete first-package workflow order, valid first versions and secret scope for both plugins and the component.
Add manual version releases with changelog freezing, immutable tags, component update-feed hashing and subsequent OctoJPack package publication.
Document release secrets and source installation requirements for maintainers and agents.

change.item: Follow the Octoleo quick starts: set up Git once, let OctoShoom hash the component download, then let OctoJPack read .octojpack directly.
Keep the component-only feed here and the package-only feed and tag-triggered OctoShoom workflow in mcp_package/.github, preserved by native OctoJPack replacement.
Select each extension's latest tag explicitly, derive the package version from the component and retain the shared versioned changelog.
Extract webservices routing into its own mcp_webservices repository and include it as a separate OctoJPack extension.
Verify tracked source archives in component and console installation tests.

remove.item: Remove local ZIP/package builders, distribution locks and generated package manifests.
Remove component-installer ownership of the webservices plugin.
Remove temporary action checkouts, configuration rendering, custom SSH setup, duplicate hash verification and package repository checks.

note.item: Tag the console and webservices plugin releases first; OctoJPack selects their latest tags.
Configure the secrets documented in docs/RELEASE.md before the first release.

addition.item: Installed JCB catalogue synchronization and confirmed command planning.
Durable owned jobs, cancellation, recovery and verified compiler artifacts.
Versioned database migrations and installed Joomla/JCB behavioural tests.

change.item: Preserve original API-user authority in workers and require a new plan for stale definitions or state.

note.item: Development baseline. See CHANGELOG.md and docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md for verification evidence.

addition.item: Database-driven MCP runtime, native administrator interface, API routing, portable SQL and shared console contracts.
